subject: Re: RiseGate launch - temporary throughput uplift & product clarifications

Subject: RiseGate launch traffic profile + temporary uplift request

Hi Logan / Laura,

Quick note from our side — we’re going live with an in-product recommendation module on Feb 25 and expect an initial 72-hour burst as the cohort flips on. Early projections (attached ingress_profile_peak_estimate.csv) show a median TPS of ~12 but 95th percentile spikes to ~48 for short windows.

We need to confirm whether Redwood can provide a temporary throughput uplift (30–50 TPS sustained for 3 days starting 02/25) and whether there are any product pre-reqs (warm-up, model pinning, KV cache priming) we should run on our end. Also attaching a draft mutual action plan — would appreciate an ops contact to coordinate cutover.

Eliza
Eliza Norton

Forwarding RiseGate's ask — they want a 30–50 TPS temporary uplift for 72 hours starting 02/25. Key asks: product pre-reqs and an ops lead for coordination.

Action items I see:
- Marissa: can quota ops provision a time-bound entitlement and confirm SLA impact?
- Karthik: product routing and fallback if we hit soft ceilings — can we route to a quantized variant to preserve latency?
- Laura/David: any product/telemetry preprocess we should ask RiseGate to do (KV priming, pinned model)?

I’m happy to be the customer point for scheduling the calls. Please reply with ETA on answers by EOD Wed (02/11) so we can get a mutual action plan back to them.

— Logan

Logan — we can do a temporary entitlement. Operational constraints and notes:
- We can grant a time-bound quota increase on 02/25 for a 72-hour window. We’ll need an exact start/end timestamp (UTC) and a signed MOP (mutual action plan) to schedule the provisioning.
- Entitlement will be applied at the customer token level; we need the API key or HubSpot customer id (you can redact the key in slack).
- Cost: we will bill uplift at the committed burst rate; finance wants a pre-approval for anything estimated >$12k over the 3 days.
- Engineering runway: provisioning takes ~4 hours to stage; to be safe we should stage the change 12–24 hours before the window and run a short warm-up.

I’ll prepare the entitlement change request once we have the MOP and the precise timestamps.

Attachments: none

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Quota & Entitlements, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RiseGate launch traffic profile + temporary uplift request

Heads-up on routing/product side:
- For short bursts we recommend routing to the 'rwb-quant-512' variant as a fallback if soft limits are approached — it preserves latency while reducing cost. We can do automated fallback by policy for that 72-hour window.
- KV priming: RiseGate should send representative warm-up traffic (approx 1% of expected peak TPS sustained over 10 minutes) to fill prefix caches. This reduces initial token latency spikes.
- Model pinning: Yes — pin the exact model sha to avoid rollout drift during launch (we'll add a pin on the control plane once you confirm).

If entitlements are in place by 02/24 we can schedule a 30-minute runbook rehearsal on 02/24 afternoon to validate routing and warm-up.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Serving

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RiseGate launch - temporary throughput uplift & product clarifications

Eliza — thanks for the profile. Quick summary and proposed mutual action plan items below so we’re aligned. Please confirm and I’ll get the entitlement request templated: 

Summary (Redwood commitments):
- Temporary uplift: 40 TPS sustained, allow short spikes to 55 TPS, 72-hour window starting 2026-02-25T16:00:00Z -> 2026-02-28T16:00:00Z.
- Entitlement provisioning: Marissa will stage the change on 02/24 (requires signed MOP + HubSpot customer id).
- Routing fallback: automated fallback to rwb-quant-512 when soft-threshold reached (Karthik).
- Warm-up: RiseGate to run 10-minute warm-up at ~0.4 TPS per expected user segment; Karthik to validate cache priming guidance.
- Telemetry: David will enable high-frequency traces for tokens and latencies for the 72-hour window and provide a post-mortem packet.

Open items for you:
1) Confirm the UTC start/end timestamps above or provide preferred ones.
2) Share HubSpot id or API key to tie entitlement (we accept redacted keys over email followed by secure upload).
3) Sign and return the attached mutual action plan PDF.

Proposed next steps:
- RiseGate confirms items 1–3 by 02/13 EOD PST.
- If yes, Marissa will create entitlement ticket and schedule staging for 02/24 14:00 UTC.
- 02/24 16:00 UTC: 30-minute rehearsal with ops + product.

Eliza — if you’re good with that I’ll attach the MOP and loop in finance for pre-approval on anticipated uplift spend.

Best,
Logan
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
